title: View text drafts can be lost while the editor is focused
detail: At a9c79387, typed view text remains in the focused editor until blur or Send. native/crates/attn-app/src/view/draw.rs:206 and view/answers.rs:183–207,219–233,274–280 trace the local state and flush paths. Abrupt app termination with focus still in the field loses unflushed text. Seed s-g4rn05 requires each answer saved as a draft when given and surviving app and daemon restarts. Persist text edits while focused and add an app-loss regression that never blurs the field before restart. Two reviewers confirmed the path in code. A fresh runtime reproduction was not completed.
